name: Circuit Zandvoort
summary: Sand dunes, banked corners and an orange crowd that doesn't stop singing.
character: Narrow and old-school, with steep banking added for the 2021 return. Overtaking is hard, so qualifying matters a lot. Sand from the dunes blows onto the track.

corners.name: Turn 3 (Hugenholtzbocht)
corners.note: A right-hander banked at about 19 degrees, so drivers can take several different lines.

corners.name: Turn 14 (Arie Luyendykbocht)
corners.note: The banked final corner, about 18 degrees, taken flat out onto the main straight.

moments.title: Villeneuve on three wheels
moments.body: When his left rear tyre failed in 1979, Gilles Villeneuve drove his Ferrari back to the pits at speed with the wheel hanging off. He retired anyway.

history.body: Last race of its first spell on the calendar.
Back after 36 years, with steep banking added.
Billed as the last Dutch Grand Prix for now.
